casualty_counts.note: The report speaks of "the loss of 1,490 lives". Established as the court's count; the true number differs between sources.
1,317 passengers (324 first class, 284 second class, 709 third class) and 891 crew. Established as that source's count, read through an extract of its table.

casualty_counts.holder: British Board of Trade figure cited by Britannica
casualty_counts.note: Britannica attributes 1,503 lives lost to the British Board of Trade. The figure does not appear in the Wreck Commissioner's report, which gives 1,490; its original document was not identified.

rescue.title: Carpathia turns toward the distress position
rescue.description: The Cunard liner Carpathia, 58 miles away, receives the call and turns toward the position given.
rescue.note: Rostron gives 12:35 a.m. by his ship's time; the message is logged at 10:35 p.m. New York time.

rescue.title: A green flare is seen from Carpathia
rescue.description: Captain Rostron sees a green flare ahead, one of those burned in boat No. 2.

rescue.title: Carpathia stops among the boats
rescue.description: Carpathia stops her engines after steering round icebergs for more than an hour.
rescue.note: Rostron: "At 4 o'clock I stopped"; the British report says 4.05.

rescue.title: First boat alongside
rescue.description: Boat No. 2, in charge of Fourth Officer Boxhall, is the first to reach Carpathia.
rescue.note: Rostron: "At 4:10 I got the first boat alongside." The time is Carpathia's; Halpern makes it 4:15 by Titanic's clocks.

rescue.title: Last boat alongside
rescue.description: Boat No. 12, the last, reaches Carpathia with Second Officer Lightoller aboard.
rescue.note: Halpern's chronology, from a table by George Behe; Wikipedia gives about 8:30 from the same table.

rescue.title: All survivors aboard
rescue.description: All the survivors are aboard Carpathia, which takes up thirteen of the boats.
rescue.note: Rostron's report to Cunard of 19 April, as cited by Halpern. The British report counts 712 people taken aboard, one of whom died soon afterwards.

rescue.title: Carpathia leaves the area
rescue.description: After a search of the area Carpathia gets under way; the Californian remains to search.

facts.title: No single figure
facts.summary: The number of people on board, saved and lost differs from one source to another: last-minute changes to the lists, aliases and the inclusion or not of some crew categories make an exact count impossible. The counts are shown side by side.
facts.note: Lost: 1,490 to 1,517 across the sources listed; saved: 706 to 712.

facts.title: Survival by class
facts.summary: By the British report, 62 per cent of first-class passengers were saved, 41 per cent of the second class, 25 per cent of the third class and 24 per cent of the crew.

facts.title: Collapsibles A and B
facts.summary: The people who reached collapsibles A and B from the water were later taken into other boats; neither collapsible was brought to Carpathia.
